The '''1959–60 Scottish Division One''' was won by [[Heart of Midlothian F.C.|Heart of Midlothian]] by four points over nearest rival [[Kilmarnock F.C.|Kilmarnock]]. [[Stirling Albion F.C.|Stirling Albion]] and [[Arbroath F.C.|Arbroath]] finished 17th and 18th respectively and were relegated to the [[1960–61 Scottish Division Two|1960-61 Second Division]].
